svg.title: TOPAK C1 — Principal, seat, cell: what an agent is made of
svg.desc: Deployment ⊃ domain ⊃ cell ⊃ seat ⊃ principal ⊃ lease. An LTRO is not a principal but a cell of them: two positions are seats that hold a Persona, a lease and a topic, two are stages that hold none, and a principal holds exactly one seat (ADR-0037 §1). Who is a principal is decided by one test: evictability by an authority other than itself (ADR-0002 A2).
svg.text: TOPAK · C1

text.tspan: Principal, seat, cell: what an agent is made of

svg.text: Deployment ⊃ domain ⊃ cell ⊃ seat ⊃ principal ⊃ lease. An LTRO is not a principal but a cell of them: two positions are seats that hold a Persona, a lease and a topic, two are stages that hold none, and a principal holds exactly one seat (ADR-0037 §1). Who is a principal is decided by one test: evictability by an authority other than itself (ADR-0002 A2).

text.tspan: A principal is anything evictable by an authority other than itself. Whatever is not is at the gate.

svg.text: Resignation is not eviction.
Principals are inside the proofs; whatever is at the gate is carried as an assumption or a declaration.
Each thinker and observer seat holder: a targeted revocation of its Persona ends that seat's lease and
nothing else, so the Observer is a principal on its own (ADR-0037 Context; ADR-0031 §5).
The correlator, and every human grant or thinker seat holder.
Promotion voters, on every rung: the anchor can evict them (ToO §7.5).

text.tspan: At the gate: outside every proof

svg.text: Anchor key-holders at archetype custody: removable only with their own consent (B14). Attributable
non-principals.
At degenerate custody a threshold or eviction rule can remove them: they become principals and the gate
moves to that rule (a type change, ToO §7.5).

text.tspan: Neither: the cell and the stages

svg.text: A cell holds no lease, speaks no alphabet and cannot be evicted as a unit; it ends when its members'
leases end. It names a binding, as a round does, not an identity (ADR-0037 §1).
Listener and Reader hold no Persona, no lease, no alphabet: nothing to evict.

archetype is the maximum.

text.tspan: Cell A (an LTRO) · holds no lease · speaks no alphabet · cannot be evicted as a unit
Cell B: another Thinker on the same Persona

svg.text: Two thinker seats on one Persona are two principals in two cells, and this is permitted: a Persona is a
property of a lease, not an identity (ADR-0037 §5).
Its own observer seat; distinctness is (thinker, observer) per cell, enforced at the promotion tally and the
deployment declaration, never at grant (ADR-0035 §5).

text.tspan: The correlator: ADR-0008's shared group, renamed and narrowed

svg.text: observer seats that belong to no cell; in W(p) for every p in the domain (ADR-0038 §1, §2).
Reads facts, envelopes and payloads of every cell at the archetype; a facts-only correlator is a permitted
narrowing (D-0038-2's mitigation).
A finding may name any principal in its domain, and is still deny-only. No admit waits on it (ADR-0043 §6).
Its detection function is unspecified (G7 item 43).
A human holds one seat too: a grant seat (ADR-0024 §5) or a thinker seat as an author, never both
A person who authors and approves is two principals; recusal is per seat and does not see through them
(finding 2; no seat-registration record, G7 item 41).
Build only: grant seats read, emit and vote; in Run they hold no variant (ADR-0043 §2).
reads every cell's topic (in W(p))

text.tspan: has the same cells and the correlator, and no grant seats
Deployment: one rung and its declared degeneracies (ADR-0023); every reference lease is rung 0

svg.text: The Thinker's Persona forms it, weights and decoder together; the mechanism's validator admits it;
the typed action is attributed to the Thinker's lease.
The Reader was never in that chain, and no stage turns thought into action.
Lost by coupling the decoder to the Thinker: the record cannot say the model and its translator disagreed.
A decoder seat would recover it at a third Persona per cell; not taken.

text.tspan: Raw emission is retained at the archetype

svg.text: Written to the round topic beside the typed action, as cognitive payload under the same ACL (0003.3),
erasure unit (ADR-0006) and retention (0003.4).
One purpose: re-run the decoder and compare. It recovers faithfulness, not intent, and never admits
anything (ADR-0007).
A deployment that does not retain declares D-0037-2 and loses decoder-faithfulness audit.
One pair per cell, (thinker, observer) (ADR-0037 §5): each cell has two cognitive seats and
ADR-0017's two lineages cover them; CR-10 closes without a third.
Enforced where refusal stalls: the promotion tally and the deployment declaration (ADR-0035 §5).
Correlation across cells from shared Personas is the correlator's concern (ADR-0023 §5).
spec/Seats.tla: OnlyThinkersAuthor and OneSeatPerPrincipal hold (6,656 states); M_KIND breaks
only the first, M_SEAT only the second; three witnesses reachable.
M_SEAT was the reference's behaviour (finding 1); the grant path now refuses a principal with a live lease
on another seat.
Floor: B10 total and discriminating on all four authoring actions.
Proved 2026.10.02: Seats_proof.tla, 110 obligations, each invariant for every behaviour of the module,
not under its mutation (ADR-0037 B25; ADR-0046).

Every row writes "none" under "theorems voided" and states the real loss in prose: ADR-0023 §6's schema has no "properties lost" field (ADR-0037 finding 6; G7 item 40). The Reader's admitting use is owed to ADR-0045 T-0045-26, a trust root at rung 3 only, which no theorem cites yet.
